description: As create.create.code_deposit_exact_gas forwarding 7,008 gas: the initcode returns 32 zero bytes with 7,000 gas left, pays the 6,400 deposit and hands the other 600 back, so the creator resumes with the 111 gas its CREATE kept plus 600; the contract is created, the JUMPI takes the success branch and the CREATE stays at its spawn estimate.
